chunks: He said, 'The lowest of the brushing of the teeth is that you rub with your finger'.
ai.seo_question: What is the minimum requirement for brushing teeth in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the minimum threshold for siwak, indicating that even a simple rub with the finger suffices, which underscores the flexibility and accessibility of this Sunnah in daily hygiene. In Shia jurisprudence, this low bar ensures that the act of purification is never burdensome, encouraging consistent practice before prayer. It reflects the broader Islamic emphasis on cleanliness as a component of faith, where ease is prioritized over rigid formalism.

en.hubeali: He<sup>asws</sup> said, ‘The lowest of the brushing of the teeth is that you rub with your finger’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali through his chain of narrators has narrated the following: “He (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
The least for brushing is using one’s fingers as a tooth brush.”
